in_marathi.name: Hemanta
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Cold, Dark, Sunless
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hemanta हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Hemant' meaning 'autumn' or 'dark'. It is often associated with the wisdom and knowledge gained during this season. The name Hemanta signifies the end of the monsoon season and the beginning of the winter season, a time of introspection and preparation for the future.
